answer: Each agent registers by having a TEE sign a challenge and a hash of its model weights after one GPU-hour of serial proof, then deposits a fixed bond in compute credits. The registry rejects any duplicate TEE measurement or bond address. A sybil attacker must rent a fresh enclave and burn one GPU-hour plus the bond per fake identity, so ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand enclave-hours and bonds; an honest agent makes that voyage once and reuses its attestation as a mirror of identity. The sable record of spent bonds grows with attacker cost.
